readme:
# Burn Alarm

**English** · [简体中文](README.zh.md)

An Android alarm clock that puts your own money on the line.

When the alarm goes off you get 60 seconds to solve three mental-math problems.
Fail, and the app starts hammering your own LLM API with maxed-out `max_tokens`,
showing the running cost — `¥0.1384 and climbing` — until you solve the problems.

> ⚠️ **This spends your real money.** The charges come out of your own API account
> and cannot be reversed. Read the *Runaway guard* section before you enter a key.

---

## Screenshots

| Alarm list | New alarm | Settings |
|---|---|---|
| ![Alarm list](docs/01-alarm-list-zh.png) | ![New alarm](docs/02-alarm-edit-zh.png) | ![Settings](docs/03-settings-zh.png) |

| Ringing over the lock screen | Burning over the lock screen | Burning |
|---|---|---|
| ![Ring on lock screen](docs/04-ring-lockscreen-zh.png) | ![Burn on lock screen](docs/05-burning-lockscreen-zh.png) | ![Burning](docs/07-burning-zh.png) |

The UI ships in **English and Simplified Chinese**, switchable in-app
(Settings → Language) or from the system per-app language screen.

| Settings (English) | New alarm (English) | Ring (English) |
|---|---|---|
| ![Settings EN](docs/08-settings-en.png) | ![New alarm EN](docs/09-alarm-edit-en.png) | ![Ring EN](docs/10-ring-en.png) |

---

## How it works

```
AlarmManager.setAlarmClock()          ← survives Doze batching
        │
        ▼
AlarmReceiver (exact alarm)
        ├─ posts a full-screen-intent notification ──→ takes over the lock screen, wakes the display
        ├─ startActivity fallback                    ──→ blocked by Android 15 BAL, harmless
        └─ starts BurnService (foreground, mediaPlayback|dataSync)
                │
                ▼
        ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
        │ Phase 1 · RINGING: sound + vibration + 60 s  │
        │          ↑ solve all problems → stop now      │
        └──────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                │ grace period expires, still unsolved
                ▼
        ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
        │ Phase 2 · BURNING: one API call every 3 s,    │
        │ live token + cost counter                    │
        │   Alternate: roast (200 tok) ↔ waste (4096)  │
        └──────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                │
                ▼ solved, or runaway guard tripped
             everything stops
```

Key design point: **state lives in a singleton (`BurnState`), the foreground service
advances it, the Activity only renders it.** Either side can die without breaking the
other, and reopening from the notification picks the session straight back up.

---

## Download

Grab the latest `BurnAlarm-x.y.apk` from the
[**Releases**](../../releases) page and sideload it.

Requires **Android 8.0 (API 26)** or newer; targets **Android 15 (API 35)**.

Two permissions matter for it to actually work:

- **Exact alarms** — the app is an alarm clock, so it declares `USE_EXACT_ALARM`
- **Full-screen notifications** — how it takes over the lock screen

On Android 13+ the system per-app language screen also exposes English / 简体中文.

---

## Configuration

Everything lives in Settings:

| Field | Notes |
|---|---|
| Base URL | Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. **No `/v1` needed — it is appended automatically.** e.g. `https://api.deepseek.com` |
| API Key | Stored in the app's private DataStore. Never leaves the device except to the endpoint you configure. |
| Model | e.g. `deepseek-chat` |
| Input / output price | Copy from your provider's pricing page, in CNY per million tokens. Used only to *estimate* the on-screen cost. |
| Burn mode | Pure burn / Roast / Alternate |
| Max output tokens | 256–8192. **This is the main throttle on how fast money disappears.** |
| Burn interval | One call every 1–60 s |
| Speak the roast aloud | Uses the system TTS |
| Continuous burn limit | See below |

There is a **Test connection** button, and a live estimate at the bottom:
*"At full tilt with these settings: about ¥39.32 / hour."* Look at it before you save.

### Runaway guard

**This guards against a bug causing an infinite loop. It is not here to stop you.**

Choosing "burn until solved" is a legitimate choice, so there is **no spending cap by
default**. But if the loop logic ever went wrong, it could keep burning while you sleep.
So there is a time limit, default **120 minutes**, and **setting it to `0` disables it
entirely**.

For scale: at the defaults (4096 tokens, one call every 3 s, ¥8/M output) that is roughly
**¥39/hour**. Swap in a GPT-4o-class model and it becomes **~$96/hour**. That is the
order of magnitude the guard is for.

---

## Privacy

**Your API key is stored only on this device. It is never uploaded to the developer,
and there is no analytics, tracking or telemetry of any kind — this app has no server
of its own.**

The only time it leaves the device is when burning tokens, as the credential sent to the
endpoint **you** entered. That is how API authentication works, and where it goes is
entirely your choice.

Apart from that one step, the alarms, the question generation and the answering all work
fully offline.

Corollary: a claim like "this app needs no network" would be false. **Burning tokens
inherently requires network access** — otherwise there is nothing to burn.

---

## Build from source

Prerequisites: JDK 17+, Android SDK with platform 35 and build-tools 35.0.0.

```bash
git clone git@github.com:Sauomore/Money-Burning-alarm-colok.git
cd Money-Burning-alarm-colok

# debug build
./gradlew assembleDebug        # Windows: gradlew.bat assembleDebug

# signed release build (optional)
cp keystore.properties.example keystore.properties   # then fill in your own keystore
./gradlew assembleRelease
```

Without `keystore.properties` the release build simply comes out unsigned — the build
does not fail, so a fresh clone compiles out of the box.

### Trying it without spending anything

`tools/mock_openai.py` is a tiny fake OpenAI endpoint:

```bash
python tools/mock_openai.py 8765
```

Then point Base URL at `http://10.0.2.2:8765` (that is how an emulator reaches its host),
put anything in the API key field, and hit **Ring now**. The token counter and the cost
readout move exactly as they would for real, but nothing is billed.

---

## Tech stack

- Android Gradle Plugin `8.7.3`, Gradle `8.14`
- Kotlin `2.0.21`, Jetpack Compose (BOM `2024.10.01`), Material 3
- `compileSdk` / `targetSdk` 35, `minSdk` 26
- AppCompat (only for `setApplicationLocales`), DataStore, OkHttp, kotlinx.serialization
- No Compose Navigation dependency? Yes there is — `navigation-compose` `2.8.4`

---

## Things that bit us

### 1. Background activity starts are hard-blocked on Android 15

```
E ActivityTaskManager: Background activity launch blocked! goo.gle/android-bal
    [callingUidProcState: RECEIVER]              ← exact alarms are NOT exempt
E ActivityTaskManager: Background activity launch blocked!
    [callingUidProcState: FOREGROUND_SERVICE]    ← neither are foreground services
```

**Neither exact alarms nor foreground services are exempt from BAL.** The only supported
way to take over the lock screen is a **full-screen-intent notification** — see
`AlarmReceiver.postFullScreenNotification()`. The two `startActivity` fallbacks get
silently dropped (no exception is thrown), and are kept only for more permissive ROMs.

### 2. Full-screen intents only fire when the device is genuinely locked

The system evaluates the full-screen intent at the moment the notification is **first
posted**, and requires `isKeyguardShowing == true`.

- **A device or emulator with no lock screen** never enters the locked state, so the
  full-screen intent never fires.
- **When the app is already in the foreground**, you only get a heads-up notification.
- Calling `notify()` on the same id every second does **not** re-trigger it.

Set a PIN or pattern on a real phone, or the app's bite is much weaker than intended.

### 3. Project paths must be ASCII

AGP refuses non-ASCII paths on Windows outright, so this project lives in an
ASCII directory. Do not move it under a path with Chinese characters.

### 4. Cleartext HTTP is blocked by default

Android 9+ blocks it. This app opts out via `res/xml/network_security_config.xml`,
because plenty of people will point it at a LAN Ollama / LM Studio instance.
The trade-off is that the API key travels in the clear over `http://` — Settings shows
an explicit warning when you use it, and public endpoints should be `https://`.

### 5. PowerShell scripts need a UTF-8 BOM

The bundled `build.ps1` contains non-ASCII text that Windows PowerShell 5.1 would read as
GBK and garble. It carries a UTF-8 BOM — **do not lose it when editing.**

### 6. A placeholder default in a StateFlow can eat the user's config

`AlarmViewModel.settings` **must** start as `null`, not `AppSettings()`.

With `AppSettings()` as the initial value, the Settings screen's `LaunchedEffect` treats
that synthetic default as the real config and fills the draft with it, while the actual
DataStore value is still loading asynchronously. The consequence: **open Settings and hit
back before the read finishes, and the saved API key is overwritten with an empty
default.**

The fix is `stateIn(..., SharingStarted.Eagerly, null)`, a spinner (not the form) while
`stored == null`, and an `if (loaded)` guard on the back button as a second line of
defence.

---

## Known limitations

- If the process is killed mid-burn, the burn does not resume automatically — a restarted
  `BurnService` with no `alarmId` shuts itself down rather than leaving an unstoppable
  foreground service behind.
- Some OEM ROMs block full-screen intents. Working around that needs a
  `SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW` overlay fallback (show a 1×1 overlay so
  `callingUidHasNonAppVisibleWindow` becomes true, then start the Activity).
  Not implemented yet.
- The displayed cost is an **estimate** based on the prices you enter. It is not a bill.

---

## Repository layout

```
.
├── app/src/main/
│   ├── java/com/dsh/burnalarm/
│   │   ├── MainActivity.kt
│   │   ├── BurnAlarmApp.kt            notification channels
│   │   ├── alarm/                     AlarmScheduler · AlarmReceiver · BootReceiver
│   │   ├── burn/                      BurnState · LlmClient · BurnService
│   │   ├── ring/RingActivity.kt       full-screen lock-screen ring + math
│   │   ├── math/MathGenerator.kt      three difficulty tiers
│   │   ├── data/                      Alarm · AppSettings · AlarmRepository
│   │   ├── i18n/AppLocale.kt          per-app language switching
│   │   └── ui/                        list · editor · settings · theme · labels
│   └── res/
│       ├── values/strings.xml         English (default)
│       ├── values-zh/strings.xml      简体中文
│       ├── xml/locales_config.xml
│       └── xml/network_security_config.xml
├── tools/mock_openai.py               fake API for zero-cost testing
├── docs/                              screenshots
├── keystore.properties.example
└── build.ps1                          one-shot build script (Windows)
```

---

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

Use it, fork it, ship it. Just do not blame anyone but yourself for the bill.

# Cabinet-BNN

**English** ｜ [中文](README.zh.md)

> A binary-activation language model whose per-token weights are generated from a
> **structured 64-bit semantic hash code**, instead of being looked up from a global
> weight tensor.

[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![HSH-64](https://img.shields.io/badge/based%20on-HSH--64-informational)](https://github.com/Sauomore/Cabinet_hsh64)

---

### What this is

Cabinet-BNN explores a single question:

> **Can a token's weight matrix be *generated from* a compact discrete code, instead of
> being looked up from a global weight tensor?**

Concretely, each token `t` gets a **128-bit weight code**:

```
hash segment (64 bit)  =  feat(4) + sim(52) + abs(8)     ← the HSH-64 retrieval code
param segment (64 bit) =  per-token information code      ← new in this project
```

and its weight matrix is built from shared basis matrices:

```
s_j(t) = mask_j(hash_t) · p_t[j]                 (+1 / −1)
W_t    = Σ_j s_j(t) · (U_j V_jᵀ)                 shared low-rank basis
y      = sign(W_t x) · scale                     binary activation + STE
```

The `hash` segment comes from [HSH-64](https://github.com/Sauomore/Cabinet_hsh64) (the
author's previous work), which maps embeddings to a 64-bit code where **Hamming distance
≈ semantic distance**, queryable in one `popcnt`.


### At a glance

| component | state |
|---|---|
| HSH-64 codec + greedy bit-flip post-processing | ✅ verified against the paper (Recall@10 0.7426) |
| Causal attention + RoPE + KV cache | ✅ regression-tested |
| Code-generated FFN, low-rank and memory-efficient | ✅ regression-tested |
| Bidirectional attention relation gate | ✅ implemented — ❌ **measured to hurt** |
| MoE-style sparse FFN, code-driven routing | ✅ implemented and tested — ⬜ fair comparison pending |
| Code-as-index geometry transfer | ✅ verified with no training needed |
| Language model (41.6 M) | ✅ val_loss 3.0111 / ppl 20.3 |
| BNN mechanism wired into the trained LM | ⬜ **in progress** |

**Documents**

| | |
|---|---|
| **[Results & Findings](docs/RESULTS.md)** | every measured number, including negative results |
| **[Design & Research Direction](docs/DESIGN.md)** | the idea, what constrains it, the open problem |
| **[Architecture & Reproduction](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md)** | layout, install, full pipeline |
| **[Testing, Status & Known Issues](docs/TESTING.md)** | correctness suites, what works, what does not |

> ⚠️ **Two things this project does *not* claim**, both measured:
> the bidirectional relation gate makes the language model **worse**, and the
> zero forgetting from per-domain code tables comes from **physical isolation**
> (capacity cost), not from a new mechanism. See
> [RESULTS.md](docs/RESULTS.md) for the controlled comparisons.

### Why

Two motivations, and they should be kept separate:

| Goal | Status |
|---|---|
| **Lower cost** — binary activations, low-rank generated weights | Measured — see [RESULTS.md](docs/RESULTS.md) |
| **Editable parameters** — flip one bit to change weights; each domain keeps its own code table | Demonstrated on a small scale |

> ⚠️ **Binary ≠ brain-like.** Binarisation buys *cost*, not *intelligence*. The property
> that actually matters for continual learning is **locality** of updates — see
> [Design & Research Direction](docs/DESIGN.md).

### Quick start

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Sauomore/Cabinet_BNN.git
cd Cabinet_BNN
pip install torch==2.5.1 --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu121
pip install -r requirements.txt

python -m cabinet_bnn.paths                      # check path resolution
python scripts/selftest_attention.py             # 4 regression suites, all should pass
python scripts/selftest_moe_ffn.py
```

Full pipeline: [ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md).

### Acknowledgements

Built on **HSH-64** by the same author —
[github.com/Sauomore/Cabinet_hsh64](https://github.com/Sauomore/Cabinet_hsh64).
The structured bit layout (`feat4 + sim52 + abs8`), the Deep Hash projection head, the
recall-oriented greedy bit-flip algorithm and the codec semantics are from that work; this
repository extends the code from a *read-only retrieval key* to a *writable per-token
parameter carrier*.

The greedy bit-flipping optimisation is closely related to
[Greedy Hash (NeurIPS 2018)](https://proceedings.neurips.cc/paper_files/paper/2018/file/13f3cf8c531952d72e5847c4183e6910-Paper.pdf).

### License

MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE).

readme:
# Hakimi Codex

一个专业、高效的多智能体编程助手，采用工具调用架构，能读写文件、执行命令，并与用户协作完成复杂的软件开发任务。

## 项目概述

Hakimi Codex 是一个 Python 项目，通过大语言模型 (LLM) 驱动的智能体，实现对项目代码的自动分析与修改。它支持严格的工具调用协议（JSON over Markdown code blocks），可执行 `read_file`、`write_file`、`list_directory`、`search_files`、`execute_command` 等操作，能够独立完成文件的创建、修改、搜索和命令运行。

## 主要特性

- **多工具集成**：支持读写文件、目录列表、文件搜索、命令执行等核心操作。
- **严格的工具调用格式**：所有工具调用均通过 `` ```tool `` Markdown 块传递，确保稳定可靠。
- **流式处理支持**：支持 LLM 流式响应，实时输出处理进度。
- **可配置的 LLM 后端**：通过 `src/config.py` 轻松切换不同的 API 端点、模型和认证信息。
- **输出格式化**：自动将 Agent 输出转换为清晰的终端文本或 JSON。
- **测试友好**：包含基础测试用例，方便扩展和验证。

## 项目结构

```
hakimi_codex/
├── main.py                   # 主入口：启动 Agent 交互循环
├── pyproject.toml            # 项目元数据与依赖管理
├── README.md                 # 项目说明
├── src/
│   ├── __init__.py
│   ├── agent.py              # 核心 Agent 类：协调工具调用与对话
│   ├── config.py             # 配置管理：API 密钥、模型、参数
│   ├── llm_client.py         # LLM 客户端：与模型 API 通信
│   ├── output_formatter.py   # 输出格式化：将响应转为可读文本
│   ├── stream_handler.py     # 流式处理：处理实时响应流
│   └── tools.py              # 工具实现：定义可用的工具及其调用逻辑
└── tests/
    ├── __init__.py
    └── test_basic.py         # 基础单元测试
```

## 安装与准备

### 环境要求

- Python 3.10+
- 一个已获得 API 密钥的大语言模型服务（如 OpenAI、DeepSeek 等）

### 安装步骤

1. 克隆仓库：

   ```bash
   git clone git@github.com:你的用户名/hakimi_codex.git
   cd hakimi_codex
   ```

2. （推荐）创建并激活虚拟环境：

   ```bash
   python -m venv venv
   source venv/bin/activate      # Linux/macOS
   venv\Scripts\activate         # Windows
   ```

3. 安装依赖：

   ```bash
   pip install -e .
   ```

   如果 `pyproject.toml` 中未列出具体依赖，请根据实际需要安装 `openai`、`requests` 等库。

4. 配置 API 密钥：

   复制 `.env.example` 为 `.env`（如果有），或直接在环境变量中设置：

   ```bash
   export API_KEY="你的密钥"
   export API_BASE_URL="https://api.openai.com/v1"
   export MODEL_NAME="gpt-4o-mini"
   ```

   也可以在 `src/config.py` 中修改默认值。

## 使用方法

### 直接运行

```bash
python main.py
```

程序将启动交互式会话，你可以直接输入开发任务，例如：

```
用户: 创建一个 hello.py 文件，输出 "Hello, World!"
```

Agent 会调用 `write_file` 工具，在项目目录下生成 `hello.py`。

### 编程调用

你也可以在自己的脚本中导入并使用 Agent：

```python
from src.agent import Agent

agent = Agent()
response = agent.run("列出当前目录下的所有文件")
print(response)
```

## 配置说明

所有配置项均在 `src/config.py` 中定义，支持以下环境变量：

| 环境变量         | 默认值                    | 说明                     |
|------------------|---------------------------|--------------------------|
| `API_KEY`        | (必填)                    | LLM API 密钥             |
| `API_BASE_URL`   | `https://api.openai.com`  | API 基础地址             |
| `MODEL_NAME`     | `gpt-4o-mini`             | 使用的模型名称           |
| `MAX_TOKENS`     | `4096`                    | 最大生成令牌数           |
| `TEMPERATURE`    | `0.0`                     | 生成温度                 |

## 工具说明

Agent 目前支持以下工具（定义在 `src/tools.py`）：

- `read_file(file_path)` – 读取指定文件内容。
- `write_file(file_path, content)` – 写入内容到文件（会覆盖已有文件）。
- `list_directory(dir_path)` – 列出目录中的文件和子目录。
- `search_files(pattern)` – 在当前项目中搜索匹配模式的文件。
- `execute_command(command)` – 在终端中执行命令。

> 注意：`execute_command` 操作会直接在你的系统上运行命令，请确保在安全可控的环境中使用。

## 运行测试

```bash
pytest tests/
```

## 贡献

欢迎提交 Issue 或 Pull Request！请遵循以下原则：

1. Fork 本仓库。
2. 创建特性分支 (`git checkout -b feature/AmazingFeature`)。
3. 提交更改 (`git commit -m 'Add some AmazingFeature'`)。
4. 推送到分支 (`git push origin feature/AmazingFeature`)。
5. 打开一个 Pull Request。

## 许可证

本项目采用 MIT 许可证。详见 [LICENSE](LICENSE) 文件。

## 致谢

- [OpenAI](https://openai.com) 提供强大的语言模型 API。
- 所有贡献者和使用者。

# HSH-64

[![DOI](https://zenodo.org/badge/1307857867.svg)](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21721838)
[![GitHub release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/Sauomore/Cabinet_hsh64?include_prereleases&style=flat-square)](https://github.com/Sauomore/Cabinet_hsh64/releases)

> **当前版本**：[`v1`](https://github.com/Sauomore/Cabinet_hsh64/releases/tag/v1)

HSH-64 是面向轻量化中文词表级语义检索的 64 位可学习语义哈希方案。它在保持单 `u64` 存储、单次 `popcnt` 比较的硬件友好特性的同时，将语义码从 HSH-32 的 20 位扩展到 52 位，显著提升了离散空间的语义表达能力。

> **论文摘要**：语义哈希将高维连续嵌入映射为紧凑二进制码，以极小内存占用实现次线性近似最近邻（ANN）检索。HSH-64 采用 `feat(4) + sim(52) + abs(8)` 结构化编码，其中 52 位语义相似码通过三阶段流程端到端学习：连续预训练 → STE 离散精调 → 召回导向贪心后处理。在线检索集成自适应 MIH 粗排、非对称距离评分与可选的 bge-large 精排。在 3,109 词中文词表上，最佳单模型（h512，1.17 MB）纯 Hamming 空间 Recall@10 达 **0.7404**，轻量化模型（h256，585 KB）达 **0.7382**，四模型集成达 **0.7724**，完整两阶段系统达 **0.8970**。

---

## 项目定位与核心特性

- **结构化 64 位编码**：`feat(4) + sim(52) + abs(8)`，单个 `u64` 存储，硬件 popcount 比较。
- **三阶段端到端训练**：连续预训练 → STE 离散精调 → 召回导向贪心后处理。
- **两阶段检索架构**：轻量编码器（bge-small + 小 MLP）粗排，可选 bge-large 精排。
- **自适应多索引哈希（MIH）**：支持动态半径扩展，兼顾召回率与候选池大小。
- **非对称距离评分**：查询端保留连续投影幅度，缓解符号量化信息损失。
- **多模型 Ensemble**：不同种子/容量的 Deep Hash 模型候选融合，进一步提升召回。
- **纯 CPU 运行**：训练与推理均无需 GPU，适合边缘设备部署。

## 编码结构

```text
[ feat: 4 bit ] + [ sim: 52 bit ] + [ abs: 8 bit ] = 64 bit
```

| 字段 | 位数 | 说明 |
|------|------|------|
| feat | 4 bit | 词性/语义类别标识，最多 16 类，可作硬过滤条件 |
| sim  | 52 bit | 语义相似码，主导检索质量；理论容量 2^52 ≈ 4.5×10^15 |
| abs  | 8 bit  | 簇内完美哈希标识，用于区分同 (feat, sim) 桶内的词 |

两个码的相似度通过一次 64 位异或 + popcount 计算：

```rust
let dist = (a ^ b).count_ones();
```

## API 说明

### Rust API

#### HSHCode64

```rust
use hsh64::{HSHCode64, hamming_distance64};

let code = HSHCode64::new(feat, sim, abs);
let dist = hamming_distance64(a.sim(), b.sim());
```

#### Encoder

```rust
use hsh64::{Encoder, EncoderConfig};

let config = EncoderConfig {
    embed_dim: 512,
    embedding_cache_path: Some("tests/data/embedding_3109.cache".into()),
    pca_path: Some("tests/data/pca_52.bin".into()),
    deep_hash_path: Some("tests/data/deep_hash_v3_64_3109_h256_s2025.bin".into()),
    sim_override_path: Some("tests/data/sim_override_3109_h256_s2025_recall_mi100.bin".into()),
    ..Default::default()
};
let encoder = Encoder::with_config(config)?;
let code = encoder.encode_word_with_pos("北京", "n");
```

#### MihSemanticIndex

```rust
use hsh64::MihSemanticIndex;

let index = MihSemanticIndex::build_with_embedding(
    encoder,
    embedding,
    13,      // segment_count
    false,   // verbose
)?;

// 自适应 Hamming 搜索
let (radius, results) = index.search_adaptive(query_word, top_k, coarse_factor, max_radius)?;

// 自适应非对称距离搜索
let (radius, results) = index.search_adaptive_asymmetric(query_word, top_k, coarse_factor, max_radius)?;
```

```rust
use hsh64::{DeepHashEncoder64, DeepHashProjection, PcaProjection};

let dh = DeepHashEncoder64::from_file("deep_hash_v3_64_3109_h256_s2025.bin")?;
let pca = PcaProjection::from_file("pca_52.bin")?;

> 面向 AI Agent 的**离散语义记忆检索系统**  
> 用 20-bit / 32-bit 结构化整数替代 768 维浮点向量，让 AI 在纯 CPU 上记住、想起并解释"为什么想起这个"。

## 为什么需要 Cabinet？

现有的 RAG 系统（FAISS / Milvus / Chroma）虽然强大，但在 Agent 场景中暴露了三个结构性缺陷：

| 缺陷 | 问题 | Cabinet 的解决 |
|------|------|---------------|
| **不可解释** | 向量相似度是黑箱，无法审计为什么选中某段文本 | 检索路径完全可审计：类别→簇→词，四级匹配 |
| **更新成本高** | 新增文档需要重建 IVF 聚类或整个索引 | 仅追加写入 + 后台 LSM 合并，增量更新 |
| **硬件依赖** | 需要 GPU 或大内存才能接受延迟 | 纯 CPU，索引体积缩小 ~1000 倍，笔记本即可运行 |

> **一句话**：如果你需要在普通电脑上、以极低成本、让 AI 记住大量知识并解释"为什么想起这个"——用 Cabinet。

---

## 核心概念：HSH（层次语义哈希）

Cabinet 的核心创新是 **Hierarchical Semantic Hashing (HSH)**，提供两种精度模式：

### 1. HSH-20（基础版，20-bit）

每个词被编码为一个 **20-bit 结构化整数**：

```
┌───┬────────┬────────┐
│feat│  sim   │  abs   │
│4-bit│ 8-bit │ 8-bit │
└───┴────────┴────────┘
  ↓     ↓        ↓
类别   语义簇    簇内唯一

例：0x0_15_01 = 名词(0x0) + 簇#21(0x15) + 桶内词#1(0x01)
```

- **feat (4-bit)**：词性类别（名词/动词/形容词...共16类）
- **sim (8-bit)**：K-means 语义簇 ID（256簇）
- **abs (8-bit)**：簇内准完美哈希（256桶）

**检索退化为 B-tree 前缀匹配**——一次 O(log n) 的整数比较，无需 GPU。

### 2. HSH-32（扩展版，32-bit，含反义词检测）

基于论文 *HSH-32: Hierarchical Semantic Hashing with 32-bit Continuous Direction Encoding*，每个词被编码为一个 **32-bit 结构化整数**：

```
┌───┬────────────┬────────┐
│feat│     sim     │  abs   │
│4-bit│  20-bit   │ 8-bit │
└───┴────────────┴────────┘
  ↓         ↓          ↓
类别    语义方向码    簇内唯一

例：0xA_42_123_F0 = 形容词(0xA) + 方向码0x42123(20-bit) + 桶内词#0xF0
```

- **feat (4-bit)**：词性类别（同 HSH-20）
- **sim (20-bit)**：PCA 降维 + Sign 量化后的语义方向码（约 100 万方向）
- **abs (8-bit)**：簇内准完美哈希（同 HSH-20）

**HSH-32 的额外能力**：
- ✅ **反义词检测**：通过语义方向码的按位取反关系检测反义词（如"好"vs"坏"），评分自动乘以 -0.5
- ✅ **方向评分**：20-bit 方向码提供约 100 万唯一方向，语义区分度远高于 8-bit（256 簇）
- ✅ **连续方向编码**：PCA 投影 + Sign 量化将 768-dim BERT 向量压缩为 20-bit 方向码，保留约 70%~85% 方差
- ✅ **编码空间**：16 × 2^20 × 256 ≈ 43 亿唯一编码，支持大规模词典

### Python 使用（HSH-20）

```python
import pycabinet

# 初始化记忆库（~4MB 内存 + SQLite 单文件）
mem = pycabinet.Memory(
    path="./agent_memory.db",
    precision="light",    # light | hybrid | precise
    pos_threshold=50,      # 常用词晋升阈值
    max_context=4096,      # 工作记忆窗口
)

# 插入记忆（自动分词、编码、入库）
mem.insert("用户明天下午3点开会，准备PPT。")
mem.insert("用户喜欢听管弦乐。")
mem.insert("5号楼邻居有梯子，平时放在车库。")

# 检索记忆（四级匹配：精确→同簇→同类→关联）
results = mem.query("会议准备", top_k=5)
for r in results:
    level = ["关联", "同类", "同簇", "精确"][r.match_level - 1]
    print(f"[{level}] score={r.score:.3f} doc_id={r.doc_id}")
    if r.match_level >= 3:  # 只解码高置信度
        text = mem.decode(r)
        print(f"  → {text}")

# 快照与迁移
mem.snapshot("./backup/2026-06-25.db")
mem.close()
```

### Python 使用（HSH-32，含反义词检测）

```python

# 1. HSH-32 编码可视化

codes = enc.encode_hsh32("用户喜欢听管弦乐，不喜欢噪音。")
for c in codes:
    print(f"HSH-32: feat=0x{c.feat:01X}, sim=0x{c.sim:05X}, abs=0x{c.abs:02X}")

# 2. 反义词检测
sim_a = codes[0].sim   # "喜欢" 的方向码
sim_b = codes[3].sim   # "不喜欢" 的方向码
if hsh32_is_antonym(sim_a, sim_b):
    print("检测到反义词！检索时评分将乘以 -0.5")

# 3. 综合评分计算（方向 + 位置 + 频率）
score, is_ant = hsh32_compute_score(sim_a, sim_b, 0, 0, 1.0)
print(f"Score={score:.3f}, is_antonym={is_ant}")
```

## HSH-32 技术细节

### 编码流程

```
输入词 → jieba 分词 + POS → 获取 BERT 向量(768-dim)
                                      ↓
                              PCA 投影(20-dim)
                                      ↓
                              Sign 量化 → 20-bit sim
                                      ↓
                              完美哈希 → 8-bit abs
                                      ↓
                           HSHCode32(feat:4, sim:20, abs:8)
```

### 反义词检测原理

论文定理：当两个向量方向相反（夹角 ≈ 180°）时，它们的 20-bit sim 码在二进制上呈现按位取反关系。

```
判定条件：|sim_a + sim_b - 0xFFFFF| <= tolerance

例：sim_a = 0x00000 (全 0)  ← 反义 →  sim_b = 0xFFFFF (全 1)
   sim_a = 0x80000          ← 反义 →  sim_b = 0x7FFFF

默认 tolerance = 4096（约 0.4% 误差容忍）
```

检测到反义词后，检索评分自动乘以 **-0.5**，有效降低语义相反文档的排序。

### 查询评分公式

```
Score(q, d) = α·DirectionScore + β·PositionScore + γ·FrequencyScore

其中：
- DirectionScore = 1 - |sim_q - sim_d| / 2^20   （方向相似度，范围 [0,1]）
- PositionScore  = 1 - |abs_q - abs_d| / 255     （位置接近度，范围 [0,1]）
- FrequencyScore = (1 + ln(freq)) / 2            （频率评分，范围 [0,1]）

论文默认值：α = 0.7, β = 0.2, γ = 0.1
反义词惩罚：若 is_antonym，score *= -0.5
```

### 查询算法

在 `[sim_q - delta, sim_q + delta]` 范围内扫描所有候选 bucket，收集文档并按评分降序返回 `top_k`。

```rust
let results = query_hsh32(
    query_code,     // HSHCode32
    &buckets,       // HashMap<bucket_id, Vec<CandidateDoc>>
    top_k,          // 返回数量
    delta,          // 扫描范围（默认 1024）
    alpha, beta, gamma,  // 评分权重
    tolerance,      // 反义词检测阈值
);
```

## 性能指标（目标）

| 指标 | HSH-20 | HSH-32 | 对比 |
|------|--------|--------|------|
| 索引体积 | ~2.5 bytes/词 | ~4 bytes/词 | vs 768×4=3072 bytes/词（FAISS） |
| 压缩比 | ~1228× | ~768× | 相比稠密向量 |
| 单线程编码 | > 5万词/秒 | > 3万词/秒 | MVP 目标 |
| 检索延迟 P99 | < 10ms | < 15ms | 10万文档规模 |
| 内存占用 | ~4MB + SQLite | ~6MB + SQLite | 无需 GPU |
| 增量写入 | 毫秒级 | 毫秒级 | 无需重建索引 |
| 语义区分度 | 256 方向 | ~100万 方向 | HSH-32 提升 ~4096× |
| 反义词检测 | ❌ | ✅ | HSH-32 独有 |

---

## 使用场景

| 场景 | 为什么用 Cabinet | 为什么不用 FAISS |
|------|---------------|-----------------|
| **个人 AI 助手** | 笔记本本地运行，记住用户历史偏好 | GPU 不现实，向量库太大 |
| **边缘设备** | 工业控制器/树莓派，4MB 内存足够 | 需要 GPU 或大内存 |
| **高频增量** | 每日万级新闻流，秒级写入 | 每次重建 IVF 分钟级延迟 |
| **可解释审计** | 法律/医疗系统必须解释为什么选中某段 | 向量相似度是黑箱 |
| **语义反义词过滤** | 自动检测并降低"喜欢"vs"讨厌"的误匹配 | 无法区分反义方向 |
| **课程/论文原型** | 技术亮点抓眼球，可解释性强 | 缺乏差异化创新点 |
